description: Fetch the full public detail for one AI tool by its listing slug (as returned by search_tools' toolUrl, e.g. '/tools/acme-writer' -> slug 'acme-writer'). Call this after search_tools to get a tool's full description, launch date, revenue signals (verified or self-reported), and for-sale status. Returns null if the slug doesn't resolve to a live Alternativas IA listing.
name: get_tool

launchDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the real launch date.

revenueVerifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last Stripe verification.

selfReported.description: Marks selfReportedMrrUsd as unverified. Never report it as verified.

selfReportedMrrUsd.description: Present only when the figure is the maker's own claim.

verifiedMrrUsd.description: Present only when the maker connected Stripe.

tool.description: null when the slug does not resolve to a live listing on this site.

title: Get AI tool detail
